Please turn this into a ticket: when I click "Export CSV" on the reports
page nothing happens. I tried Chrome and Firefox. Exporting from the API
still works.
case_results.response:

```
TICKET-V1
## Summary
Clicking "Export CSV" on the reports page does nothing (no file download) in Chrome and Firefox, while exporting from the API still works.
## Severity
P2
## Steps to Reproduce
1. Navigate to the reports page.
2. Click the "Export CSV" button.
3. Observe that nothing happens — no CSV file is downloaded.
```

- Steps are the minimum implied by the report. If you want, I can add environment details (OS, browser versions) or a "Expected vs Actual" section once more info comes in.
